title: Matching edges meeting a part
statement: Let $q,k$ be natural numbers, and let a perfect matching be given in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part. For a specified part, the associated edge set consists of the matching edges having an endpoint in that part.
hypotheses_covered: The graph is complete $q$-partite with $k$ vertices in each part
